text.content:
Star Journal (written in old empire)

-325 BC (Sister Salla)

Filverl has granted me permission to begin efforts to construct the
metal men. I’ve sent for engineers to assist with the creation of the
laboratory.

-315 BC

Construction continues apace. We were able to recruit some Dwarven
engineers which greatly enhanced our efforts in getting the facility up
and running. We’ve taken to calling it Gravestone, due to the proximity
of Gravestone Lake. It also makes for a nice distraction if we are asked
where we are going, merely to Gravestone.

Filverl’s son, Camus quite fancies his dalliances with human women. I’ve
sent word back home to send out comely assistants and replacements to
cater to his fancies.

- 270 BC (Sister Mira)

I’ve arrived and taken over from Sister Salla. It seems that the reports
about Camus are accurate. He has wasted no time in expressing interest
in me.

Progress on the project has been slow but steady.

-265 BC

Filverl has turned over control of the project to Camus, which has
worked to our favor. His carnal appetite continues unabated. I have
secured sufficient resources from him to bring in some more staff. These
wizards aren’t cheap. I am confident in my ability to lead Camus to
where we need him, as his interest in the project extends about as far
as my dress.

- 250 BC (Sister Amala)

Sister Amala arrived to take over lead efforts. I see she was well
prepared for her assignment. She wasted no time attracting Camus’
attentions.

-225 BC (Sister Amala, Brother Ruben)

Brother Ruben arrived today. Lady Sarya has been taking more interest in
leading the project, as Camus has had to shift his attentions to other
matters of the Elven Houses. Lady Sarya Lightfoot, Camus’ sister, is
very interested in reducing the need for their Glades, and so is willing
to support our project. She is also partial to a certain type, which I
told Mother and requested an assistant that fits her fancy.

-215 BC

Lady Sarya provided several subjects at our request. We are getting
closer to creating a soul stone, which should allow us to animate the
metal forms with intelligence. Unfortunately, the first rituals and
sacrifices were unsuccessful. Fortunately, there is a ready supply of
subject to experiment on from the Glades. The elves do not seem to mind
the reduction in population, and perhaps see it as a benefit as it saves
them from having to do the deed.

-210 BC

We have successfully crafted a few soul stones with the help of Lady
Ashryn, Sarya’s sister. It appears that the trick is having the right
quality soul. We discovered several lineages that were influenced by
Celestials in their past are particularly desirable for making soul
stones, as they have the necessary power and resiliency to survive the
process.

- 205 BC

With Lady Ashryn’s help, we were able to animate several prototypes.
I’ve sent reports back to Mother and received confirmation on Star Hill
on our process. I’ve stationed several units here at the estate to
protect this lab as we move onto the next steps.
